business_problem: High-quality visuals significantly shape a potential customer’s experience, yet creating compelling display ads remains a challenge for many vendors. Considering that 80% of Mercado Libre’s sellers are SMBs, they were looking for a solution tailored to empower SMBs and accelerate their growth on the platform through its ad products.
solution_summary: Mercado Libre Reshapes Retail Media with AWS Partner Mutt Data and Stability AI in Amazon Bedrock Mercado Libre has partnered with AWS Partner Mutt Data to address the challenge of producing high-performing banner ads with generative artificial intelligence (AI), for dozens of thousands of smaller sellers. Mercado Libre developed GenAds, an innovative solution that automates the creation of compelling product images, streamlining the process for sellers and enhancing their market presence with image-generating AI. Through GenAds, Mercado Libre helped small sellers through image generation for advertising, enabling sellers of all sizes to attract customers, increase click-through rates (CTR) by an average of 25%, and boost sales effectively. GenAds: A New AI-Driven Product Imaging Service Mercado Libre selected AWS Partner Mutt Data to develop a cutting-edge solution to streamline the creation of high-quality product images for its sellers.

business_outcome: 45% More Impressions and 25% Higher Click-Through Rate with GenAds After an initial expansion phase with a small batch of invited sellers and a few countries, Mercado Libre's GenAds launched unrestrictedly mid-Q2 and has already seen remarkable results. GenAds has been rolled out across seven Latin American countries, including the region’s three largest economies: Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina.
